verified.reason: The V3_SWAP_EXACT_IN input is encoded with payerIsUser=true, so the Aerodrome/Uniswap Universal Router sets payer=adapter (≠ router) and pays the CL pool via PERMIT2.transferFrom in the swap callback, but the adapter only grants a plain ERC20 allowance to the router and never approves Permit2 nor sets a Permit2 allowance, so every Slipstream/CL swap reverts unconditionally on a documented, unprivileged path with no guard.
